question: On ballast/core bags, does earlier partial (A), soft trail (C), or A then C beat ride-to-8%-SL after a real green path?

scope.note: Tryout shells stay on trail-TP + W2 fuse sketch — not this CF.

control.label: Actual / ride to 8% SL (or actual fill)
control.description: What happened (or first touch of 8% if no fill path).

A.label: Earlier partial bank
A.description: First time path MFE >= 3%: bank 33% at arm mark; residual keeps 8% disaster stop from entry.

C.label: Soft trail / ratchet after green
C.description: First MFE >= 3%: arm stop at max(entry*(1+be_buffer), peak*(1 - lock_frac*peak_r)). Stop only ratchets up with new peaks. Full exit on touch.

AC.label: A then C on residual
AC.description: Partial at +3%, then soft-trail the residual. 8% still disaster floor on residual until trail is tighter.

scoring.promote_bar_note: No live GO until n>=5 ballast legs with would-arm and net delta clear of fee; never promote on single ETH ghost.

do_not: Apply A/C knobs to <=$30 tryout shells in this shadow
Merge A+C into one unlabeled live knob before attribution
brad_go_intent: Brad GO reverse-stack #2 2026-10-17: implement/arm bank-trail path. Sunday gates still N_INSUFFICIENT (would-arm 3/5). live_apply stays false until letter GO on winner arm.
